mercimek.name: Isupu ya Lentile
mercimek.description: Isupu ya lentile yo mu rugo itewe mu buryo gakondo, irangizwa n'isosi y'amavuta y'intama.

tas-kebabi.name: Ibishyimbo by'Inyama y'Inka ya Turkish
tas-kebabi.description: Inyama y'inka, imboga zo mu gihe, n'isosi idasanzwe y'aho muri resitora itogosheje gahoro gahoro.

kuzu-tandir.name: Intama yatogoshejwe buhoro
kuzu-tandir.description: Intama ya tandoori y'akarango ka resitora yacu, itogoshejwe buhoro ku ziko ryoroshye.

pirinc-pilavi.name: Umuceri wa Pilaf
pirinc-pilavi.description: Umuceri wa Baldo urimo amavuta, woroshye kandi uhumura neza.

firin-sutlac.name: Ubuki bw'umuceri bwatekeshejwe mu ifuru
firin-sutlac.description: Ubuki bw'umuceri bwatekeshejwe mu buryo gakondo, buteguwe n'amata y'inka ya buffalo buri munsi.

kuru-fasulye.name: Isupu y'ibishyimbo byera n'inyama y'inka
kuru-fasulye.description: Ibisembo bya İspir, inyama y'inka icagaguritse, n'isosiyete ya tomate isanzwe yo muri resitora.

izgara-kofte.name: Inyama z'ibibabi ziteguye ku muriro
izgara-kofte.description: Inyama z'inka ziteguye nka butcher hamwe n'ibirungo by'ikirunga n'inyanya.

ayran.name: Ayran ivanganye
ayran.description: Amavuta ya buttermilk gakondo afite umwuzure mwinshi, akorwa n'ubuki busanzwe bwa yoguti.

ezogelin-corbasi.name: Isupu ya Ezogelin
ezogelin-corbasi.description: Isupu gakondo ya resitora aho ibishyimbo by'umutuku, bulgur, n'umuceri byubakana na minti.

tarhana-corbasi.name: Isupu ya Tarhana
tarhana-corbasi.description: Tarhana yo mu rugo, ikinyarwanda cya Anatolia itegurwa buhoro buhoro hamwe n'inyanya n'umunetsi wakanye.

yayla-corbasi.name: Isupu ya Yoguti n'Umuceri
yayla-corbasi.description: Isupu ikonje kandi yoroshye ya yayla ikozwe muri yoguti, umuceri, n'ibibabi by'umutonyanga byumye.

iskembe-corbasi.name: Isupu y'Imboga z'Inyama z'Inka
iskembe-corbasi.description: Isupu y'inyama z'inka ikozwe neza iteguye hamwe n'ibirungo byayo na vinegere ya tungurusumu.

dugun-corbasi.name: Isupu y'Ubukwe
dugun-corbasi.description: Isupu gakondo y'ubukwe ikozwe mu nyama y'ihene yatomowe kandi icuruzwa n'amavuta ya limoni.

tavuk-suyu-corbasi.name: Isupu y'Inkoko
tavuk-suyu-corbasi.description: Isupu ikiza ikozwe n'imisohoro mito ibikwa mu buliri bw'inyama z'inyama hamwe n'inyama y'inkoko yatomowe.

domates-corbasi.name: Isupu ya Tumatire
domates-corbasi.description: Impumuro ikungahaye yatekwemo inyanya zikuze, amavuta, na basil, irangijwe n'ibirayi.

sebze-corbasi.name: Isupu y'imboga
sebze-corbasi.description: Isupu yoroheje yo muri resitora yakozwe n'imboga z'igihe, amavuta ya elayo, n'ibyatsi bishya.

beyran-corbasi.name: Isupu y'Inyama y'Intama Ishyushye ya Beyran
beyran-corbasi.description: Isupu y'akarere itewe ku muriro mwinshi hakoreshejwe inyama y'intama, umuceri, tungurusumu, n'igitunguru gishyushye.

kelle-paca-corbasi.name: Isupu y'Umusoro n'Akarimwe
kelle-paca-corbasi.description: Isupu ikungahaye ku magufa yakozwe n'umusoro w'inka n'inyama y'umusoro yatetse amasaha menshi.

sehriye-corbasi.name: Isupu ya Vermicelli
sehriye-corbasi.description: Isupu ya buri munsi ikozwe mu isosi y'inkoko hamwe n'inyanya, vermiselli, na peteroli.

tavuk-sis.name: Ibibabi by'Inkoko
tavuk-sis.description: Ududomo tw'inkoko twatewe amavuta n'ibirungo byihariye, dutegurwa hamwe n'ibirayi byokeje n'inyanya.

kasap-sucuk.name: Amarangi y'Inyama y'inka Yumye ku muriro
kasap-sucuk.description: Isosi y'inyama y'inka ifite akanyafu ku muriro, hamwe n'imboga zokeje n'ibitunguru bifite sumac.

karisik-izgara.name: Gushushanya ku Muriro
karisik-izgara.description: Icyo kurya cyuzuye kandi gitandukanye kigizwe n'umutobe w'inyama, ibibabi by'inkoko, amashaza y'ingurube, n'isosi.

nohut-yemegi.name: Isupu y'Ibishyimbo hamwe n'Inyama y'inka
nohut-yemegi.description: Icyokurya cy'iwanyu cya kabichi n'inyama y'inka yacagaguriwe buhoro buhoro mu isafuriya ya kopore.

patlican-musakka.name: Moussaka y'ibitunguru by'umweru
patlican-musakka.description: Ibitunguru by'umweru by'inka byotswe, inyama y'inka, na moussaka ishyushye mu ifuru hamwe na sauce ya tomate, mu buryo bw'amarestora.

zeytinyagli-taze-fasulye.name: Ibishyimbo by'icyatsi mu mavuta y'ibihwagari
zeytinyagli-taze-fasulye.description: Icyokurya gakondo cyatewemo mu mavuta y'ibihwagari hamwe n'ibishyimbo by'icyatsi, inyanya, n'ibitunguru, bitetse gikonje.

tavuk-sote.name: Inkoko ishushanyije mu mavuta
tavuk-sote.description: Udusate tw'inkoko dushushanyijwe hejuru y'umuriro mwinshi hamwe n'ubwoko butandukanye bw'ibirungo, ubugari, n'inyanya.

izmir-kofte.name: Inyama zikorwa mu buryo bwa İzmir
izmir-kofte.description: Icyokurya gakondo gikozwe n'inyama y'ihene zikoze umupira, ibirayi, n'ibitunguru byotsa mu isosi y'inyanya.

etli-bezelye.name: Ibishyimbo n'Inyama y'ihene
etli-bezelye.description: Ifunguro rya buri munsi ritegurwa mu isafuriya rikozwe mu nyama y'ihene icagaguye, ibishyimbo, karoti, n'ibirayi.

patlican-oturtma.name: Inyanya y'ibirayi n'inyama zicagaguye
patlican-oturtma.description: Ururimi rutewe mu ifuru hamwe n'ibirayi, inyama zicagaguye zitewe n'ibirungo, n'isosi y'inyanya n'umutunguru.

salgam-suyu.name: Umuneke w'ikinyomoro cyahindutse
salgam-suyu.description: Umuneke gakondo w'ibitunguru wuzuyeho karoti y'ubururu n'urumogi rwa bulgur.

maden-suyu.name: Amazi ya Minerale
maden-suyu.description: Amazi karemano ya minerale atetse akonje.

su.name: Amazi y'Isoko Kamere
su.description: Amazi y'isoko kamere atetse akonje mu icupa ry'ikirahure.

kola.name: Cola
kola.description: Ikirungo gisanzwe cyuzuye gaze gitangwa gikonje cyane.

gazoz.name: Soda y'indimu ya Kisilike
gazoz.description: Soda gakondo ifite uburyohe, ishushe kandi itangwa ikonje ifite uburyohe bw'umwimerere.

turk-kahvesi.name: Icyayi cya Kisilike
turk-kahvesi.description: Icyayi cya Kisilike gakondo gifite umwuma, gitekerea ku ziko rihiye cyane mu isafuriya ya kashe.

demleme-cay.name: Icyayi Gishyushye cya Kisilike
demleme-cay.description: Icyayi gishyushye gishya cya Rize gitanzwe mu icupa rigufi rifite igituza cyoroheje.

ev-yapimi-limonata.name: Lemonade yo mu rugo
ev-yapimi-limonata.description: Lemonade isukuye itewe buri munsi n'imizambwe mishya, minti, n'isukari nkeya.

hosaf.name: Compote y'imbuto ya buri munsi
hosaf.description: Compote yo mu rugo ishyushye buri munsi hamwe n'imizabibu, abrikoti, cyangwa amaplamu bitewe n'igihembwe.

iskender-kebabi.name: Bursa İskender Kebab
iskender-kebabi.description: Inyama ikorwaho urushinge hejuru ya pide, itangwa ifite isosi y'inyanya, amavuta ashyushye, na yoguti.

kazandibi.name: Umutobe w'amata w'ikarameli
kazandibi.description: Umutsima gakondo w'amata ukarahirwa neza, ufite ubunyamavuta bwo hejuru.

tavuk-gogsu.name: Umutobe w'amata w'Abotomani
tavuk-gogsu.description: Isukari yoroshye kandi ifite ibyuma bya fibre ikozwe n’amata, itewe n’ubuhanga gakondo, ikabikwa hamwe n’ikirungo cya sinamoni.

keskul.name: Pudding y’amata y’Ibihwagari
keskul.description: Isukari y’amata mu buryo bwa Ottoman yuzuye n’impumuro y’ibihwagari n’umunyu w’itorero.

irmik-helvasi.name: Halva ya Semolina
irmik-helvasi.description: Halva ya semolina, itetse mu butari n’imyembe y’ibiti by’inzitiramibu, ikabikwa ishyushye kandi ifite uduce twayo.

kabak-tatlisi.name: Isukari y’Igikakarubamba hamwe na Tahini
kabak-tatlisi.description: Igikakarubamba, gitogoshewe gahoro gahoro mu mariba yacyo, gikabikwa hamwe na tahini n’imbuto z’umunyu.

ayva-tatlisi.name: Isukari y’Igitoki cya Quince
ayva-tatlisi.description: Igitoki cya quince, gitogoshewe hamwe n’ikariso na sinamoni, gikaba gitewe hamwe n’amavuta akomeye n’imbuto z’umunyu.

revani.name: Ikeke rya Semolina Riseye Sirupe
revani.description: Umukino w'ikirangirire muri resitora aho ikeke rito rya semolina rihura na sirupe iryoshye ifite impumuro ya limon.

ekmek-kadayifi.name: Pudingi y'Umugati n'Agafu k'Amata Gatogosheje
ekmek-kadayifi.description: Pudingi y'umugati ruhutse hamwe na sirupe yanyanyaguwe itangwa hamwe n'agafu k'amatako k'inka za buffalo.

cevizli-baklava.name: Baklava y'Inyanya z'Umwembe
cevizli-baklava.description: Amashami aringanijwe neza, baklava yumutetse ikozwe n'inyanya nyinshi hamwe n'amavuta asukuye.
